title: R6, R7-1, R7-2, R8 residence districts (ZR 23-22 wide-street conditional) - maximum residential floor area ratio (conservative value)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the maximum residential floor area ratio for the four ZR 23-22 districts whose standard value is NOT a flat lookup - R6, R7-1, R7-2 and R8. ZR 23-22 footnote 1 gives each of these a HIGHER standard FAR within 100 feet of a wide street and a LOWER FAR otherwise (R6 3.00 vs 2.20; R7-1/R7-2 4.00 vs 3.44; R8 7.20 vs 6.02), and footnote 1 says 'or portions thereof' so a single lot can be split between both values - a geometry computation, not a table lookup. This rule returns ONLY the CONSERVATIVE (lower) value because a wide-street determination is not performed; the higher wide-street value is surfaced as an explicit conditional alternative and is NEVER the returned result. NOT a Verified determination - a candidate representation awaiting raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval. effective_from is the section's Last Amended date (2024-12-05): evaluating as_of an earlier date yields a visible not-effective outcome.

citations.quote: MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA RATIO FOR R6-R12 DISTRICTS. R6 3.00(1) / 2.20; R7-1, R7-2 4.00(1) / 3.44; R8 6.02, R8 7.20(1). Footnote 1: For zoning lots, or portions thereof, located within 100 feet of a wide street.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: The residence district governing the lot (or the portion under evaluation). District SCOPE is enforced by applicability (in_set R6/R7-1/R7-2/R8). An uncertain M2-T013 geometric assignment is passed via spatial_context and downgrades coverage.

inputs.name: lot_area_sq_ft
inputs.description: Zoning-lot area in square feet; must be strictly positive. A zero/negative/non-finite value is rejected fail-closed (professional_review_required, no computed value).

inputs.name: housing_program
inputs.description: Whether the lot contains standard residences or qualifying affordable / qualifying senior housing (the two ZR 23-22 columns). When absent, the qualifying-housing alternative is surfaced as conditional (not decided).

outputs.name: max_residential_far
outputs.description: CONSERVATIVE (lower, non-wide-street) maximum residential floor area ratio for standard residences: R6 2.20, R7-1/R7-2 3.44, R8 6.02. The higher wide-street value is deliberately NOT emitted as a result.

outputs.name: max_residential_floor_area_sq_ft
outputs.description: Maximum residential floor area = lot area x the conservative FAR.

parameters.name: standard_far_by_district
parameters.note: CONSERVATIVE (non-wide-street) standard-residences maximum residential FAR: R6 2.20, R7-1/R7-2 3.44, R8 6.02 per ZR 23-22. This is the value the rule returns; the higher wide-street value is surfaced separately and never applied. Candidate values pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

parameters.name: wide_street_far_by_district
parameters.note: HIGHER standard-residences FAR that applies ONLY within 100 feet of a wide street (ZR 23-22 footnote 1): R6 3.00, R7-1/R7-2 4.00, R8 7.20. SURFACED via the wide_street_far_alternative exception and NEVER applied or emitted as a result, because a wide-street determination is not performed. Provenance-linked here so the value is byte-checkable against the snapshot; deliberately not consumed by a computation step.

parameters.name: qualifying_far_by_district
parameters.note: Qualifying affordable-housing / qualifying senior-housing maximum residential FAR for the non-wide-street rows of these districts (ZR 23-22 second column): R6 3.90, R7-1/R7-2 5.01, R8 7.20. SURFACED via the qualifying_housing exception, never applied by this rule. Provenance-linked here so the value is byte-checkable against the snapshot; deliberately not consumed by a computation step.

parameters.name: wide_street_qualifying_far_by_district
parameters.note: Wide-street QUALIFYING (footnote-2) maximum residential FAR: R8 8.64 (ZR 23-22 footnote 2), which sits ONLY on the qualifying value of R8's wide-street row. Its condition is COMPOUND - outside a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area AND within 100 feet of a wide street AND containing UAP developments or qualifying senior housing - so it is neither computed nor emitted; it is SURFACED via the r8_wide_street_qualifying_footnote_2 documented_limitation. Provenance-linked here so the value is byte-checkable against the snapshot; deliberately not consumed by a computation step. R8 is the only ZR 23-22 district carrying a footnote-2 value.

steps.note: Select the CONSERVATIVE (non-wide-street) standard-residences maximum residential FAR for the district (R6 2.20, R7-1/R7-2 3.44, R8 6.02).
Maximum residential floor area = lot area (sq ft) x the conservative FAR.

exceptions.description: Within 100 feet of a wide street (ZR 23-22 footnote 1), a HIGHER standard-residences FAR applies: R6 3.00 (vs the conservative 2.20), R7-1 and R7-2 4.00 (vs 3.44), R8 7.20 (vs 6.02). Footnote 1 says 'or portions thereof', so a single lot can be split between the two values - a geometry computation, not a table lookup. A wide-street determination is NOT performed by this rule and the higher value is NEVER returned; the conservative (lower) value is the result and the higher value is surfaced here as a conditional alternative only.
exceptions.note: Always surfaced (condition null): overstating one of these lots by using the wide-street value without a wide-street determination is the single worst output this family can produce, so the higher value is never applied here.

exceptions.description: A higher maximum residential floor area ratio (the ZR 23-22 second column) applies to zoning lots containing qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing: R6 3.90, R7-1/R7-2 5.01, R8 7.20 (for the non-wide-street rows). Whether a development qualifies is a separate legal determination and is not decided by this rule; when the housing program is unknown or qualifying, the result is conditional and the higher FAR may apply.
exceptions.note: Surfaced, never collapsed: the conservative standard-residences FAR is reported with an explicit conditional flag that a qualifying-housing FAR may govern.

exceptions.description: For R8 ONLY, the wide-street row additionally carries a qualifying affordable/senior-housing FAR of 8.64 (provenance-linked in the wide_street_qualifying_far_by_district parameter) under ZR 23-22 footnote 2, whose condition is COMPOUND - outside a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area AND within 100 feet of a wide street AND containing UAP developments or qualifying senior housing. None of those three are determined here; this value is neither applied nor emitted, only recorded as a documented limitation. Scoped to zoning_district R8 so it is not attached to R6/R7-1/R7-2 results, whose ZR 23-22 rows carry no footnote 2 (footnote-scope discipline, cf. AS-4).

special_district_interactions.description: Special Purpose Districts (ZR Articles VIII-XIV) and other mapped overlays may modify residence-district floor area. When a mapped special district applies, its provisions govern and must be evaluated by the corresponding special rule; this general rule does not apply the modification.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage is downgraded to professional_review_required (or data_conflict) and the geometric uncertainty is recorded in the trace.

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

Only the CONSERVATIVE (non-wide-street) standard-residences FAR is computed; the higher wide-street FAR (footnote 1) is surfaced as a conditional alternative and never returned, because no wide-street determination is performed.
The qualifying affordable / senior housing FAR (ZR 23-22 second column) and the R8 footnote-2 8.64 value are surfaced (conditional / documented limitation), not computed.
Footnote 1's 'or portions thereof' means a single lot may be split between the wide-street and non-wide-street values; that split is a geometry computation this draft does not perform.
Special Purpose District and other overlay modifications are not applied.
